sloka: तथा पौर जनस्य अपि कर्तव्याः च सुविस्तराः ।आगतानाम् सुदूरात् च पार्थिवानाम् पृथक् पृथक् ॥१-१३-११॥
transliteration: tathā paura janasya api kartavyāḥ ca suvistarāḥ ।āgatānām sudūrāt ca pārthivānām pṛthak pṛthak ॥1-13-11॥

translations.english: In the same manner let widely spread residential accommodation be furnished with many items of food and all kinds of entertainment be provided for people from other lands.
